definitions: The power or quality of delighting, attracting, or fascinating others.
A small ornament worn on a necklace or bracelet.
An object, act, or saying believed to have magic power.
A quality or feature that makes something very attractive or desirable.
examples: She has a lot of charm.
He gave her a charm bracelet.
They believed in good luck charms.
The charm of the old village was undeniable.
